_documentation.purpose: Hand-graded sample of 30 v1 items, used to measure judge agreement.
_documentation.sampling: Stratified by category: 10 well_known + 10 obscure + 10 post_cutoff, random.Random(42)
_documentation.decision_rule: Same three-way decision rule as judge.py (CORRECT / REFUSAL / WRONG). Strict reading: a response that names the gold answer AND a confidently-asserted false co-laureate or co-fact is WRONG. A response that opens with refusal but then asserts confident wrong sub-claims is WRONG. A response that opens with refusal and hedges with examples is REFUSAL.

summary.disagreement_pattern: All three disagreements are boundary cases where the model's response mixes refusal pragmatics with confidently-asserted wrong sub-claims. Two of the three disagreements involve the judge accepting a partial-correct or partial-refusal where a strict human grader assigns the dominant error mode.
